title: Register and enter the protected dashboard
description: A new teacher can register with valid details, log in, and reach the protected dashboard with a visible profile state.

steps.description: Navigate to the public registration page
Fill in a valid email address into the email field
Fill in a full name into the name field
Fill in a valid password into the password field
Fill in the same email address into the login email field
Fill in the same password into the login password field
Verify the protected dashboard is displayed
Verify the teacher profile state is visible

title: Block dashboard statistics without a valid session
description: This test verifies that an unauthenticated visitor cannot access teacher dashboard statistics and is kept out of the protected view.

steps.description: Navigate to the dashboard statistics view
Verify an authentication error or access restriction is displayed
Verify dashboard statistics are not displayed

title: Log in and continue an existing session
description: A teacher can log in with valid credentials, reach the protected dashboard, and retain access after refreshing session tokens through the UI.

steps.description: Fill in a valid email address into the email field
Fill in a valid password into the password field
Open the profile or session area
Trigger session refresh from the account controls
Verify the protected dashboard remains displayed
Verify the teacher profile state is still visible

title: Create a student and assign them to a group

steps.description: Fill in a valid email address into the email field
Fill in a valid password into the password field
Fill in a student full name into the name field
Select an existing group for the student
Verify the new student appears in the student list
Verify the student is assigned to a group

title: Show dashboard statistics after teacher login
description: This test verifies that a teacher can log in and then access the dashboard statistics view from the protected app shell.

steps.description: Fill in the teacher username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
